technical.zh-CN: AIYA 面向 14 岁以上人群，标注五自由度和记忆图谱；飞燕面向养老机构，提供到场陪伴、认知互动、提醒和服务留痕，两者用途不同。
technical.en: AIYA targets users aged 14 and older, with five degrees of freedom and a memory graph. 飞燕 provides in-person companionship, cognitive interaction, reminders and service records in elder-care institutions. The uses differ.
